_comment: Canonical example of the JSON Gemini returns from /api/triage extraction. Matches the ExtractedReport schema in main.py. The server adds `id` and `created_at` before storing; absent fields come back as the string "n/a" (coordinates as null).

example.name: Ana Müller
example.title: Gas leak, two trapped in Berlin
example.summary: A gas leak on Oak Street in Berlin has left two people trapped inside a building that is now on fire.
example.notes: Two occupants reported trapped; active fire with possible explosion risk.
example.other_data: Reporter is on-site and unharmed; requesting fire and rescue units.
